unresolved.notes:
Not repairable from here: every URL on www.pointephemere.org, including robots.txt, returns HTTP 402, so the site itself is refusing us.
Cause: HTTP 402 "Payment Required" comes back for /agenda, /agenda/, the homepage, the bare domain (pointephemere.org/agenda), /programmation, /api/events and /robots.txt. When a whole site answers 402, the usual reasons are a suspended hosting or CDN account or an edge block/paywall. It is not a URL move or a markup change, so the parser is not at fault.
Changed: nothing (venues.json and venues_html.py are untouched).
Check result: ok=false, count=0 (prev 50), error "HTTP 402 for https://www.pointephemere.org/agenda".
For a human: open https://www.pointephemere.org/agenda in a browser. If it loads there, the 402 is only for bots, so ask the venue to allow us or find another feed (ticketing site, e.g. Shotgun/Dice). If it is down for everyone too, wait for the venue to restore its hosting and re-run the check. The pointephemere parser should work again once the page is served.
